publication_boundaries: Identity resolution does not transfer knowledge, intention, control, benefit, responsibility or liability.
A person, organisation, analytical structure, institution and proceeding never share or substitute for the same ID.
An unresolved brand, group, legal-form variant or perimeter remains open until primary evidence fixes the exact legal identity.
A missing public profile is a publication-coverage gap, not evidence of uncertain identity or reduced relevance.
Aliases and source literals resolve to the canonical record without erasing the original wording.
Protected private-source identifiers and reversible vault locators never become public IDs.
Corrections and contrary identity evidence update the same immutable ID and remain visible.
